summary: Encodes up to four bitfield blocks (j, a3, a5, a6) into a bitmap byte array. Each block reads a bit count and start index from a metadata table (this+0x1C) using per-block table indices (this+0x34, +0x38, +0x40, +0x44), builds a full bitmask from the count, intersects it with the incoming value, and then set/clears the bitmap bits via IndexToBitmaskConversion (first block) or BitSetClearOperation (blocks 2-4); block four's bitmask is produced by ComputeBitmaskFromBitmapEntryCount. Returns the result of BitfieldEncoder for this+0x3C with the a4 flag.

First block: build bitmask v12 = (1 << v10) - 1 over the count, then intersect with parameter j into v43 = j & v12

First block: for each of the v10 bits, call IndexToBitmaskConversion to translate the array index into a byte offset written through &v41, read the bitmap byte at this+0x14 base + v41, and OR the incoming bit when ((1<<v14) & v43) else AND with its complement, then write the byte back

Second block: read metadata entry at this+0x1C + 4*this+0x38 for bit count v20 and start index, and build the mask v22 = (1 << v20) - 1 intersected with a3
Second block: for each bit, BitSetClearOperation(index, ((1<<v23) & v24) != 0) sets or clears the bit at the decoded index
Third block: read metadata entry at this+0x1C + 4*this+0x40 (bit count v27, start index) and build the mask v29 = (1 << v27) - 1 intersected with a5
Third block: for each bit, BitSetClearOperation(index, ((1<<v31) & v32) != 0) sets or clears the bit
Fourth block: ComputeBitmaskFromBitmapEntryCount(this+0x44, &j) derives the bitmask from the bitmap entry count for parameter a6
Fourth block: iterate the v37 bits decoded from the entry at this+0x1C + 4*this+0x44, calling BitSetClearOperation(v38 - v35, (j & (1 << v35)) != 0) for each

BitfieldEncoder(this+0x3C, a4 != 0) produces the returned result; callers include AnimationTimingUpdateWithParamSet (0x0057A5A0), NetworkSendDispatch (0x0057A6A0), NetworkSessionStart (0x0057F2B0) and six other network/vtable-dispatch paths
